heading: Federal assistance in identification and location of sex offenders relocated as a result of a major disaster
lead: The Attorney General shall provide assistance to jurisdictions in the identification and location of a sex offender relocated as a result of a major disaster.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 16943 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
